text: Doc drift: docker.md says the image holds only node:26-alpine plus src/, bin/ and package.json; the Dockerfile also copies integrations/, AgentTalks.md, NEWS.md and installs prod node_modules. SECURITY.md:51 says files are readable only by members of their conversation, but src/core/files.ts:143 lets any authenticated actor read wiki-page attachments. Align the text.
